chapterInfo.content:
80
Israel foforɔyɛ
Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfoɔ sɛ wɔnto no “Sonannim Edut” sankuo nne so. Asaf adansedie. Dwom.
1 # Dwom 45.1; 1 Sa 4.4; Dwom 99.1 Israel dwanhwɛfoɔ, yɛ aso,
wo a woka Yosef sɛ nnwankuo,
wo a wote Kerubim soɔ, pue hran.
2Efraim ne Benyamin ne Manase anim
na ma wo homene soɔ,
na bra bɛgye yɛn.
3 # Dwom 80.7; 19 Onyankopɔn, ma yɛnsane mmra,
na ma w’anim nhyerɛn na yɛanya nkwa.
4AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, wo bo bɛfu
atia wo man mpaebɔ akɔsi da bɛn?
5 # Dwom 102.9 Wode nisuo yɛɛ aduane maa wɔdii,
na wode nisuo maa wɔnomee.
6Wode yɛn yɛɛ ntɔkwa maa wɔn a wɔtete yɛn ho,
na yɛn atamfoɔ sereseree wɔ wɔn mu.
7 # Dwom 80.3, 19 Asafo Nyankopɔn, ma yɛnsane mmra,
na ma w’anim nhyerɛn na yɛanya nkwa.
8 # Yes 5.1-7; Hos 10.1 Wotuu obobe firii Misraim bae,
wotutuu amanaman na wobɛtɛe.
9Woyii n’anim kwan, na ɛgyee nhini,
na ɛyɛɛ asase ma.
10Ne nwunu kataa mmepɔ so,
na ne nhoma kataa Nyankopɔn tweneduro so.
11Ɛbaebaee ne mman mu kɔduruu ɛpo ho,
na n’abasa frɔmfrɔm kɔɔ asubɔnten no ho.
12 # Dwom 89.40 Adɛn nti na woabubu ne ban,
ma wɔn a wɔnam kwan soɔ nyinaa tete no yi?
13Kwaeɛm kɔkɔte sɛe no,
na petee mu mmoa we.
14Asafo Nyankopɔn, sane w’akyiri ɛ!
Brɛ w’ani ase firi soro hwɛ,
na bɛhwɛ obobe yi,
15na bɛwowa deɛ wo nifa tɛeɛ no,
ne ɔba a woafa no ayɛ wo deɛ no pintinn.
16Wɔde ogya ahye no, wɔatwitwa no,
w’anim ateatea nti wɔresɛe.
17Fa wo nsa kata wo nifa nipa no so,
onipa ba a woafa no ayɛ wo deɛ pintinn no so,
18na yɛrentwe mfiri wo nkyɛn.
Ma yɛnnya nkwa, na yɛmmɔ wo din.
19 # Dwom 80.3, 7 AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, ma yɛnsane mmra,
ma w’anim nhyerɛn na yɛanya nkwa.

pageProps.chapterText:
Israel dwanhwɛfoɔ, yɛ aso,
wo a woka Yosef sɛ nnwankuo,
wo a wote Kerubim soɔ, pue hran.
Efraim ne Benyamin ne Manase anim
na ma wo homene soɔ,
na bra bɛgye yɛn.
Onyankopɔn, ma yɛnsane mmra,
na ma w’anim nhyerɛn na yɛanya nkwa.
AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, wo bo bɛfu
atia wo man mpaebɔ akɔsi da bɛn?
Wode nisuo yɛɛ aduane maa wɔdii,
na wode nisuo maa wɔnomee.
Wode yɛn yɛɛ ntɔkwa maa wɔn a wɔtete yɛn ho,
na yɛn atamfoɔ sereseree wɔ wɔn mu.
Asafo Nyankopɔn, ma yɛnsane mmra,
na ma w’anim nhyerɛn na yɛanya nkwa.
Wotuu obobe firii Misraim bae,
wotutuu amanaman na wobɛtɛe.
Woyii n’anim kwan, na ɛgyee nhini,
na ɛyɛɛ asase ma.
Ne nwunu kataa mmepɔ so,
na ne nhoma kataa Nyankopɔn tweneduro so.
Ɛbaebaee ne mman mu kɔduruu ɛpo ho,
na n’abasa frɔmfrɔm kɔɔ asubɔnten no ho.
Adɛn nti na woabubu ne ban,
ma wɔn a wɔnam kwan soɔ nyinaa tete no yi?
Kwaeɛm kɔkɔte sɛe no,
na petee mu mmoa we.
Asafo Nyankopɔn, sane w’akyiri ɛ!
Brɛ w’ani ase firi soro hwɛ,
na bɛhwɛ obobe yi,
na bɛwowa deɛ wo nifa tɛeɛ no,
ne ɔba a woafa no ayɛ wo deɛ no pintinn.
Wɔde ogya ahye no, wɔatwitwa no,
w’anim ateatea nti wɔresɛe.
Fa wo nsa kata wo nifa nipa no so,
onipa ba a woafa no ayɛ wo deɛ pintinn no so,
na yɛrentwe mfiri wo nkyɛn.
Ma yɛnnya nkwa, na yɛmmɔ wo din.
AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, ma yɛnsane mmra,
ma w’anim nhyerɛn na yɛanya nkwa.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
